note: Core constructor metadata agreement subsequently strengthened; allocated four-GPU correctness gate tests frozen production payload.

preparation_tests.scope: tiny H5AD reader, pairing/QC, deterministic representations/order, exact blocked distances and manifest

kernel_tests.scope: single-process and three-rank CPU/Gloo, both precisions, uneven and empty partitions, exact/sketch/KL/FW parity

runner_integration.scope: two-rank saved-output and independent loss/metrics parity; float32 state release before validation

resource_gate_tests.scope: fail closed for missing/invalid/nonfinite results and resource thresholds

runner_and_campaign_tests.scope: two-rank integration, direct loss and metrics, solver state release, memory gates, source/config/data/rank binding and pair matching

full_population_replacement.scope: All QC-passing pairs reused without refit; unchanged GPU kernels retain their prior local validation and will be validated in the new allocation.
